name: Gallywix Rocketway Exchange
summary: The Gallywix Rocketway Exchange is a bustling transit station positioned along the Bilgewater Cartel's high-speed rocketway in Azshara. Located adjacent to Trade Prince Gallywix's lavish Pleasure Palace, the depot shuttles goblins and visitors across the reshaped coastline at breakneck speeds. It serves as a stark display of goblin engineering, ambition, and cutthroat commerce.

sections.title: A High-Speed Gateway
sections.body: Perched conveniently near the opulent Gallywix Pleasure Palace, the Rocketway Exchange functions as an integral terminus for the Bilgewater Cartel's sprawling overhead transit network across Azshara. Operated by daredevil rocket-jockeys and supported by local tinkerers like Leezle Spinspark, the platform caters to those moving swiftly between cartel outposts. The exchange greets travelers with characteristic goblin warmth: pay your debts or clear off the tracks. It stands as a brazen monument to goblin industrial excess, carved deep into Azshara's ancient hillsides.

faq.q: What is the Gallywix Rocketway Exchange?
faq.answer: It is a Bilgewater Cartel transit station built to service the high-speed rocketway traversing Azshara, located right beside the Gallywix Pleasure Palace.
The platform is staffed by Bilgewater Rocket-jockeys who pilot and manage incoming rocket cars, along with vendors like Leezle Spinspark supplying engineering components.
The Bilgewater Cartel constructed the elevated rocketway system to rapidly transport personnel, luxury goods, and industrial materials across Azshara directly to Trade Prince Gallywix's doorstep.

faq.q: Is the exchange safe to use?
faq.answer: Like most goblin engineering feats, safety takes a back seat to speed and profit. As the local rocket-jockey's greeting suggests, successfully arriving in one piece is worth celebrating.

angles.text: Engineers can appreciate the sheer audacity of an overhead rocketway system, with local merchant Leezle Spinspark offering specialized engineering supplies right on the platform.
As an asset of the allied Bilgewater Cartel, the rocketway offers Horde adventurers rapid passage and logistical support through the transforming landscape of Azshara.
